d: Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin hold their fifth meeting of 2026, reaffirming their strategic partnership ahead of Donald Trump's expected talks with both leaders in China. As the APEC Summit brings 21 Asia-Pacific economies together in Shenzhen, Beijing and Moscow are presenting a united message on global trade, Western sanctions and a multipolar world order. With Russia increasingly reliant on China for trade and economic support, the meeting raises questions about the balance of power and Trump's diplomatic challenge. Hem Saroya tells you more.
